scope: Bending members / Section 8 current-SP16 runtime and DAG closure

discrepancies.finding: Legacy package equation (61) used a superseded/incorrect c_xr expression involving an extra c_xf term. Current SP16 requires (alpha_f*r + 0.25 - 0.0833/r^2)/(alpha_f + 0.167).
discrepancies.production_change: standard_core.bending_members.bimetal_major_axis_coefficient_eq61 now evaluates the current-SP16 expression; the legacy first parameter is retained only for call compatibility and is mathematically inert.

discrepancies.finding: The detailed package exposed many Section 8 atomic calculations but lacked a branch-safe guided route that evaluates only the applicable beam path.
discrepancies.production_change: Added standard_core.bending_workflows.bending_member_guided_workflow plus explicit profile/material pre-schema hydration and strict branch routing.

discrepancies.finding: NormCAD historical DSL calculates sigma_loc,cr,1 with division by lambda_a to the first power. Current SP16 equation (92) divides by lambda_a squared.
discrepancies.production_change: No NormCAD behavior imported. Package existing equation (92) and Stage N4 current DAG use lambda_a^2.

discrepancies.finding: Pre-existing mixed SP16/SP554 DAG nodes for Annex Ж explicitly consume Ryn/fy_norm because they were adapted for the SP554 fire-transformation context. They are not a valid direct representation of current ambient SP16, which uses design Ry.
discrepancies.first_divergent_atomic_step: E/Ry strength basis in Annex Ж phi calculation
discrepancies.production_change: DAG v0.3.33 adds current-SP16 Ry-based nodes for Ж.3, Ж.6 and Ж.7 and a current phi_b/Eq.(69) chain, while preserving historical shared Ryn nodes for SP554 transformed invocation.

discrepancies.finding: DAG v0.3.32 contained many lower-level SP16/SP554 bending quantities but did not encode the Stage N4 current-SP16 guided beam orchestration as a separate auditable route.
discrepancies.production_change: DAG v0.3.33 adds explicit beam state, strength-route classification, Eq.(41)/(42)/(61), current Annex Ж chain, Eq.(69), lambda_w screen and Eq.(92) evidence node.

discrepancies.finding: Final audit attempted strict-schema validation on raw reference-bearing guided examples before deterministic profile/material hydration, causing a false schema failure.
discrepancies.production_change: Extracted private runner helper _prepare_case_for_validation and reused the same preparation pipeline in final_audit before strict schema validation.

discrepancies.finding: The guided path performs the 8.5.1 and 8.5.9 geometry/stiffener screen only; full interaction equations (80)-(100) remain in the existing dedicated bending_member_local_stability action.
discrepancies.production_change: Guided output reports SCREEN_ONLY_FULL_8_5_INTERACTION_REMAINS_SEPARATE and never silently returns a local-stability PASS.
